_howto: Elections polled by the Enhanced Voting adapter (server/src/adapters/enhancedvoting.js). host = the results site's host, slug = the jurisdiction slug in /results/public/{slug}, publicElectionId = elections[].publicElectionId from GET https://{host}/results/public/api/jurisdictions/{slug}. counties:false = emit statewide units only (RI reports by town and the source doesn't say which county a town is in). Set enabled:false to stop polling one without deleting it.

elections.name: Virginia 2026 November General
elections.note: 133 localities = 95 counties + 38 independent cities; the cities map to their own FIPS (510-840).

elections.name: Utah 2026 General Election
elections.note: No U.S. Senate or Governor race in 2026; 4 House districts. No vote-method split.

elections.name: Washington 2026 General
elections.note: No U.S. Senate or Governor race in 2026; 10 House districts. All-mail state: publishes 'Estimated Ballots Left to Count' by county.

elections.name: Rhode Island 2026 Statewide General Election
elections.note: Reports by town (39 towns + a 'Federal' UOCAVA unit) with no town-to-county mapping, so statewide only. Town breakdowns are still read to sum precincts reporting.
